design_note: Tilt limit is measured from world vertical; on this aircraft the trim thrust axis is 34.1 deg from vertical at 20 m/s, so the class cannot hold trim much above ~20 m/s. No aero feed-forward and no velocity integrator. The work order limits CPID to hover and low-speed cruise.
